title: Every pair of ends
notes: The same array, the naive way: for each start i, extend the end j and keep the sum. Row i of the triangle holds the sums of A[i..j]. 45 sums and 45 comparisons find the same A[2..5] = 8 that one pass finds in 9 sums and 18 comparisons. Each column's largest sum is the run the pass keeps.
